summary: Admit bounded Деловые Линии terminal-to-terminal shipment creation through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing authenticated shipment route resolves tenant-scoped account configuration before invoking the Dellin creator.
Terminal mode sends only explicit terminal references and bounded shipment fields; neutral address fields are omitted from the provider payload.
No public schema change is required because the existing optional pickup_point_ref field carries the receiver terminal reference.
No event envelope, event type or event payload changes.
The Dellin connector reuses the existing shipment-create operation and narrows terminal references in its adapter.
The optional sender terminal is stored in the existing runtime configuration boundary without a new table or migration.
Fixed-host HTTPS, callback-scoped credentials, numeric remote-reference validation and omission of unused address fields are enforced.
Terminal creation reuses the existing approval-bound shipment worker and write-sensitive policy checks.
The existing shipment operation receipt and audit boundary remain unchanged.
The existing create path does not retry an ambiguous external result, and the terminal branch adds no second external call.
The branch uses only the fixed official Dellin HTTPS request endpoint and adds no inbound callback.
Shared request timeout, response bounds and normalized errors cover the additional payload variant.
Removing the optional config mapping or terminal branch immediately closes terminal creation while leaving address creation available.
Deterministic tests verify both terminal references, no address objects, configuration requirements and unchanged normalized success.
